title: Introduce zone-aware egress policy prioritizer and DNS TTL coordinator for control plane
author: Maya Chen
description: Motivation: control plane egress in multi-AZ private deployments can experience noisy-neighbor and asymmetric routing issues when outbound policies are uniform across zones. This PR introduces a zone-aware egress policy prioritizer plus a DNS TTL coordinator to reduce cross-AZ flapping during failovers and improve cache coherence across peered VPCs. Implementation: 1) Terraform: add a new module resource 'zone_egress_policy' which allows per-subnet/zone preference weights and conditional security-group attachments; migration helper generates mapping from existing policies to the new structure. 2) Installer runtime: add an egress prioritizer component that evaluates request context (source subnet/zone, model shard affinity, and configured weight) to select preferred NAT/egress endpoint while still providing fallback. 3) DNS: add a TTL coordinator service that can optionally harmonize resolver TTLs and perform a short-lived lower-TTL sweep during controlled failover windows to accelerate cache convergence. 4) Helm/Chart: expose new values for feature gates, prioritizer weights, and coordinator tuning; default is off (permissive) to avoid surprise behavior. Rollout & safety: feature gate defaults to disabled; terraform migration emits a plan and requires manual approval; Helm chart ships with canary annotations and a staged rollout doc included in this PR. Testing: unit tests for policy matching and TTL adjustment logic, integration e2e against a small AWS test account with two AZs, and CI pipeline additions (terraform plan, helm lint, unit, and e2e). Backwards compatibility: designed to be opt-in with no mandatory schema change for existing installs. Related: ENG-4821 SRE-129 SUP-8371. Notes: requires infra coordination to run the terraform state migration and a short maintenance window for initial DNS TTL harmonization. See changed_files for locations and the tests section for verification steps.

release_notes: - Add zone-scoped egress policy prioritizer to improve cross-AZ control plane egress stability and reduce noisy-neighbor impact. - Introduce DNS TTL coordinator to align resolver TTLs across peered VPCs during controlled failovers, reducing cache divergence. - Terraform module additions (zone_egress_policy) and migration helper script. - Helm chart values to enable feature gate and fine-tune prioritizer/TTL behavior. - Rollout guidance and rollback steps included.
rollback_plan: If issues are observed: 1) Toggle feature gate off via Helm to return to permissive egress behavior. 2) Re-deploy previous helm image/tag if needed. 3) Run terraform apply with previous module version and restore state snapshot produced before migration. 4) For DNS, coordinate a reversion sweep to the prior TTLs using the coordinator reverse mode. Detailed step-by-step in docs/operational/egress-rollout.md.
test_plan: Unit tests cover prioritizer matching and TTL adjustments; integration tests validate end-to-end selection in a two-AZ test account; CI pipeline runs terraform plan and helm lint; e2e is gated behind a stable job and re-run on flakes. Staged rollout includes canary region, health probes for control plane API, and automated rollback on elevated error rate.
notes: Manual infra coordination required for terraform state migration and a short maintenance window for initial TTL harmonization; migration script creates a reversible plan and backup snapshot. Linear and support tickets referenced in description.
